title: A prostate MRI deep-learning system transfers to independent same-vendor institutions
summary: A previously validated deep-learning system (UNETM) was applied to bi-parametric MRI from an external institution, a matched internal cohort and a public challenge subset (250, 250 and 140 exams). ROC AUCs were 0.80, 0.87 and 0.82. Dice versus radiologist lesions was 0.36 and 0.49 in the first two cohorts.
ai_technology: UNETM deep-learning system for detecting and segmenting clinically significant prostate cancer
organization: German Cancer Research Center; Heidelberg University

evidence.tested: External and public data not used in training, with histopathology reference.
evidence.unknown: Same-vendor MRI only; moderate Dice; existing model; full text not reviewed.
